A diaspore is a dispersal unit. It can be a seed, a fruit, a mericarp or a fruit with its persistent perianth, and the lexicon lists it as a synonym of both seed (PO_0009010) and fruit (PO_0009001). Which one is meant depends on the taxon, so it should be resolved from context, not by one rule.

target: fruit (PO_0009001)
reason: Narrower: the hip of Rosa is a false fruit, a fleshy hypanthium enclosing achenes. Floras describe it as the fruit (scarlet, globose, fleshy). It is not a pome (PO_0030110).

label: leaf rachis segment
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0020055 (leaf rachis)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the portion of a leaf rachis (PO:0020055) between two successive pairs of pinnae or leaflets.
reason: A real structure (Fabaceae, especially mimosoids), measured separately from the whole rachis. Mapping it to leaf rachis would set its length (2-6 cm) against the rachis length. It comes from one flora only, so keep it in FLOPO and propose it to PO only if other floras need it.

target: leaf lamina adaxial epidermis (PO_0000050), via the surface context (the surface of a dorsiventral organ is PO's epidermis class for that side)

target: scale leaf (PO_0006003), base region: plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) part of scale leaf
